title: Serious sins
intro: Sins that take a person out of Islam.

learn.html: Besides small and major sins, a person can commit serious sins – sins that take the person out of Islam. So it is very important for Muslims to know them.

items: Kufr – disbelief in Allah and the basic truths of faith, and denying them
Shirk – associating partners with Allah, believing there are other gods besides Him
Riddah – leaving Islam, when someone openly says they are leaving Islam or are no longer Muslim
Nifaq – hypocrisy: openly claiming faith while secretly denying it
mocking, ridiculing or insulting Allah, His messengers, the Qur’an, the Ka‘bah, Salah, masjids and other holy things
denying the fard duties Allah commanded and the haram He forbade

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) was asked what sin is, and said: “Sin is what troubles you in your chest and what you would not like people to find out.” (Muslim)
A person who commits one of these sins stops being a Muslim. To become Muslim again, they must make tawbah – repent with the heart – and say the Shahadah.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: We use the word “worship” only for Allah, the Most High.

options: Sins that take a person out of Islam
Showing faith openly but denying it secretly

questions.q: What must someone do to return to Islam?
options: Make tawbah and say the Shahadah

questions.q: What is sin, according to the hadith?
options: What troubles you inside and you wouldn’t want people to know
